subscriptionRole.Name: HCW Terraform Subscription Scope
subscriptionRole.Description: What the HCP Terraform run identity (id-plat-terraform-prod-cus-01) must do at subscription scope and nothing else: create and update the resource groups infra/ declares, keep the two subscription budgets, and register the resource providers in var.azure_resource_providers. No resourceGroups/delete: at subscription scope that verb deletes ANY resource group and everything in it, which is the blast radius scoping Contributor to the managed groups removes. Everything inside a group comes from Contributor on that group. Created, scoped and assigned by scripts/bootstrap-terraform-oidc.ps1 (estate review 2026-10-06, SEC-1).
